svg.title: Certificate issuance and renewal
svg.desc: Cloudflare DNS-01 validates private hostnames through public DNS, without an inbound HTTP challenge.

g.text: Cloudflare DNS-01 validates private hostnames through public DNS, without an inbound HTTP challenge.
Self-checks use public DNS-over-HTTPS with recursive-nameservers-only to avoid split-DNS answers.
Preserve the ACME account and TLS Secrets; deleting them can consume certificate-authority rate limits.
ESO refreshes the Secret every minute. The SOPS-encrypted Git copy is a recovery backup.
